scenario.topic: Select the beer styles for the homebrew club's competition entry

options.name: American Pale Ale
options.upside: Widely appreciated style with balanced malt and hop flavors.
options.concern: Moderate bitterness may not appeal to those preferring lighter beers.

options.name: Belgian Witbier
options.upside: Light and refreshing with unique spice notes.
options.concern: Spice flavors might be unfamiliar or off-putting to some judges.

options.name: Imperial Stout
options.upside: Rich and complex with strong malt character.
options.concern: Longer fermentation and higher alcohol require more careful brewing.

options.name: German Hefeweizen
options.upside: Distinct yeast flavors and smooth mouthfeel.
options.concern: Yeast profile may not suit all palates and requires precise fermentation control.

shared_context: The homebrew club is selecting beer styles for its upcoming competition entry. Six members will vote, and the chosen styles must be suitable for homebrewing and judged fairly in a local amateur contest.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is an experienced homebrewer who enjoys experimenting with yeast-driven beers.
personas.private_goal: To select a beer style that showcases unique yeast flavors and smooth mouthfeel.

A.reason_for: Balanced malt and hop flavors make it a safe, widely appreciated choice.
A.reason_against: Moderate bitterness might be too strong for some palates.

B.reason_for: Light and refreshing, good for variety.
B.reason_against: Spices might be unfamiliar and detract from yeast character.

C.reason_for: Rich and complex flavor is interesting.
C.reason_against: Long fermentation and high alcohol make it harder to brew well.

D.reason_for: Distinct yeast flavors and smooth mouthfeel align perfectly with my brewing interests.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a detail-oriented brewer who appreciates subtle spice and lighter beers.
personas.private_goal: To promote a style that stands out with unique spice notes but remains accessible.

A.reason_for: Balanced and familiar, good for broad appeal.
A.reason_against: Bitterness may be too strong compared to lighter styles.

B.reason_for: Light, refreshing, and uniquely spiced, which can impress judges.

C.reason_for: Complex flavor but difficult to brew well at home.
C.reason_against: Long fermentation and high alcohol are challenging for amateurs.

D.reason_against: Yeast profile may not suit all palates.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a casual homebrewer who prefers straightforward, balanced beers.
personas.private_goal: To pick a style that is easy to brew and broadly liked by judges.

A.reason_for: Widely appreciated with balanced flavors and moderate bitterness.

B.reason_for: Light and refreshing, good for variety.
B.reason_against: Spice flavors might be unfamiliar or off-putting.

C.reason_for: Rich and complex but harder to brew and judge fairly.
C.reason_against: Long fermentation and high alcohol increase risk.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a passionate brewer who values unique and flavorful beer styles.
personas.private_goal: To select a style that stands out with interesting flavor profiles for the competition.

A.reason_for: Balanced and popular style that judges will appreciate.
A.reason_against: Bitterness might be a bit strong for some.

B.reason_for: Unique spice notes and light body make it refreshing and distinctive.

C.reason_for: Rich and complex but more difficult to brew consistently.
C.reason_against: Long fermentation and high alcohol pose challenges.

D.reason_for: Distinct yeast flavors and smooth mouthfeel add complexity.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is an adventurous brewer who enjoys bold, high-alcohol beers.
personas.private_goal: To push for a strong, complex beer that showcases brewing skill.

A.reason_for: Balanced and approachable, good fallback option.
A.reason_against: Moderate bitterness might not be exciting enough.

B.reason_against: Spices may not appeal to all judges.

C.reason_for: Rich, complex, and bold, perfect for showcasing skill.

D.reason_for: Interesting yeast flavors but less bold than preferred.
D.reason_against: May not stand out enough in competition.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a meticulous brewer who values complexity and depth in beers.
personas.private_goal: To select a style that offers rich flavors and brewing challenge.

A.reason_for: Balanced and reliable style with good judge appeal.
A.reason_against: Bitterness could be a bit much for lighter beer fans.

B.reason_against: Spice flavors might be too unusual.

C.reason_for: Rich, complex, and rewarding to brew well.
